## Summary

What does this PR change, and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Content (posts, docs)
- [ ] Refactor / tooling
- [ ] Other

## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check` passes (lint, typecheck, unit tests, build)
- [ ] `bun run test:e2e` passes (if pages, content rendering, routing, or the MDX/math pipeline changed)
- [ ] New logic has a unit test; new user-facing behavior has an E2E spec
- [ ] `docs/` updated if behavior changed
- [ ] No secrets or `.env*` files committed

## Screenshots / recordings

If applicable, add before/after screenshots or a short recording.

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything the reviewer should pay special attention to.
